## Knowledge change

Explain the guide, reference correction, finding or generated research update.

## Evidence and validation

Exact targets/revisions, reproduction, observed results, checks actually run
and remaining limitations. Review navigation/catalog/graph consistency and
research checksums where applicable.

## Public scope and rights

Confirm no mod/tool implementation, release package, game input, private source,
player data or credentials. Retain research provenance and original attribution.
For implementation elsewhere, return a safe summary and explain withheld scope.
Source merge, release and deployment remain separate statuses.
